unlocks.name: Gargoyle Smasher
unlocks.notes: Gargoyles are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a rock hammer in their inventory.

unlocks.name: Slug Salter
unlocks.notes: Rock slugs are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a bag of salt in their inventory.

unlocks.name: Reptile Freezer
unlocks.notes: Desert lizards are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has an ice cooler in their inventory.

unlocks.name: 'Shroom Sprayer
unlocks.notes: Mutated zygomites are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has fungicide spray and fungicide in their inventory.

unlocks.name: Malevolent Masquerade
unlocks.notes: Learn to assemble a Slayer helmet, which requires level 55 Crafting.

unlocks.name: Ring Bling
unlocks.notes: Learn to craft a Slayer ring, which requires level 75 Crafting.

unlocks.name: Broader Fletching
unlocks.notes: Learn to fletch broad arrows (level 52 Fletching), broad bolts (level 55 Fletching), and amethyst broad bolts (level 76 Fletching).

unlocks.name: Seeing Red
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, and Nieve will be able to assign you red dragons as your task.

unlocks.name: Watch the Birdie
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, Nieve, Chaeldar, and Krystilia will be able to assign you Aviansie as your task. Requires level 60 Agility or 60 Strength to unlock.

unlocks.name: Hot Stuff
unlocks.notes: Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar will be able to assign TzHaar as your task. You will be offered a chance to slay TzTok-Jad.

unlocks.name: Like a Boss
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, Krystilia, and Nieve will be able to assign various boss monsters as your task.

unlocks.name: Reptile Got Ripped
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar will be able to assign Lizardmen as your task.

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Certain Slayer monsters will have the chance of spawning a superior version whilst on a Slayer task.

unlocks.name: Duly Noted
unlocks.notes: Mithril dragons drop mithril bars in banknote form while killed on assignment.

unlocks.name: Stop the Wyvern
unlocks.notes: Stops you getting Fossil Island Wyvern tasks, without counting towards your blocked task limit. This does not cancel a current fossil wyvern task.

unlocks.name: Double Trouble
unlocks.notes: Slaying Dusk and Dawn now counts for two kills towards your task rather than one.

unlocks.name: Basilocked
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, and Nieve will be able to assign Basilisks as your task.

unlocks.name: Actual Vampyre Slayer
unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar will be able to assign Vampyres as your task.

unlocks.name: Task Storage
unlocks.notes:
Gain the ability to store your task.
Once unlocked the operation is controlled by the tasks tab of the reward option.
You can freely swap between your current task and stored task by using the reward talk option on any slayer master.

unlocks.name: I Wildy More Slayer
unlocks.notes: Krystilia will be able to assign Jellies, Dust Devils, Nechryaels, and Abyssal Demons as your task.

unlocks.name: Warped Reality

unlocks.name: Wings Spread
